measurement.statistic: Arithmetic mean of all candidate per-run sample medians, in nanoseconds; two or four runs as specified by the cohort.
measurement.scope: Top-level date and measurement settings are the September 13 historical defaults; per-cohort measurement fields override them for September 20 results. Rows use matched Citadel and SQLite runs from their declared source and cohort. This is not a full-suite run at the latest revision.
measurement.uncertainty: Each run retains its own Criterion 95% median interval. No pooled confidence interval or aggregate speedup across rows is claimed; within-role drift is retained, separately for each block in balanced cohorts.
